verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Carta's API/OAuth platform and MCP-based data queries for cap table figures (stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes, FMV) but contains no mention of a shareable 'data room' feature that bundles cap table views with underlying legal/diligence documents for external counsel or investors. Missing for 10: any documentation of a permissioned data-room UI, document repository/sharing controls, or counsel/investor-facing diligence workflow.
